open_cases.definition: Service cases currently in that status (not limited to the window).

completed_jobs.definition: Service cases completed inside the window.

cycle_time.definition: Average hours from the garage accepting the request to the job being completed, for jobs completed in the window that have both timestamps.

repeat_customers.definition: Customers (requesters) with more than one service case with this garage, of all customers with a case.

upcoming_confirmed.definition: Confirmed appointments that have not started yet.

no_show_rate.reason: Fewer than 5 cases so far (0); a rate would not mean anything yet.
no_show_rate.definition: No-shows ÷ (fulfilled + no-shows) for appointments that started in the window.

sent_in_window.definition: Estimate versions sent to a customer inside the window.

approval_rate.definition: Accepted ÷ (accepted + declined) among estimates decided in the window. Superseded and cancelled versions are not decisions.

outstanding_by_currency.definition: Live invoices’ totals minus the payments the garage recorded.

recorded_payments_by_currency.label: Recorded by the garage. CarUp has not processed or verified these payments.

estimate_vs_invoice.definition: Invoiced total vs the accepted estimate it replaced, per currency, for jobs invoiced in the window. Different currencies are never compared.

money.note: Invoiced amounts are documents, and recorded payments are the garage’s own declarations. Neither is revenue.

work orders are not decomposed into timed tasks
no warranty or comeback linkage between service records exists
Foundation deliberately publishes no ratings, so none can be measured
no record states whether a repair resolved the reported fault
Communications owns response time; no governed join to service cases exists yet
Revenue is an accounting judgement. CarUp holds invoice totals and payments the garage itself recorded; it does not know what the garage has earned.
No governed cost-of-sales or overhead record exists, so no profit can be stated.
Enquiries are not linked to outcomes by any governed record, so a conversion rate would be invented.
No governed definition and no complete payment history exist.
A forecast is a model, not a measurement; none is defined.
